parsed.name: MXR系列示波器
parsed.description: MXR系列示波器是一类多通道数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电压随时间变化的波形。它适合电子电路调试、通用波形观测、自动量测与统计分析，以及在实验室中对多路信号进行快速自动缩放和比较。
parsed.description_en: The MXR Series is a family of multi-channel digital oscilloscopes used to acquire, display, and analyze voltage waveforms over time. It is suited for electronics debugging, general waveform observation, automatic measurements and statistical analysis, and quick autoscaling and comparison of multiple signals in laboratory work.

actions.description: 读取当前测量统计窗口中的统计结果。
actions.description_en: Read the statistics currently shown in the measurement statistics window.

actions.description: 对指定通道执行自动缩放，自动调整显示以便观察波形。
actions.description_en: Perform autoscale on the specified channel to automatically adjust the display for waveform viewing.
